name: Claude Code · Sonnet 5.5
prompt:
Make a vertical hand-drawn whiteboard explainer video (lines drawn stroke by stroke, handwritten text, arrows and little doodle icons, like someone explaining while drawing on a whiteboard).

Content: the 50/30/20 budget rule — half of your take-home pay goes to needs, 30% to wants, 20% to savings, and why it keeps you on track.

Requirements:
- Vertical 1080×1920, 30 fps, 15–25 seconds
- Music and sound effects; export one mp4 with audio to the current directory
